mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[mutmut]
# Mutation test scope — service + repository layers per SAB.json scope_layers.
# Round 89 站2: this file is regenerated from the SAB at the P2→P3 handoff
# (the scope decides what mutation_testing is judged on, so a drift here
# blocks Gate 2/3/4 with the framework's "scope disagrees with SAB" infra
# failure rather than silently picking a side).
runner=python3 -m pytest -m mutation_oracle --tb=no -q -p no:cacheprovider
paths_to_mutate=03-development/src/taskq_api/service,03-development/src/taskq_api/repository

[tool:pytest]
# Gate 2 evaluation expects an integration suite under 03-development/tests/integration/
# (NFR-10). That directory mirrors tests/test_*.py via symlinks so the framework's
# `pytest 03-development/tests/integration --cov=03-development/src` invocation
# produces a real measurement. Without this directive pytest's default discovery
# would collect BOTH copies on `pytest --ignore=harness/tests` (i.e. `make
# verify-system`), and a pytest session that finds the same test function under
# two node-ids fails with collection errors. `norecursedirs` makes the
# integration mirror opt-in: explicit `pytest 03-development/tests/integration`
# still walks into it (the path is on the command line), but a bare `pytest`
# from the project root skips it.
